_note: FM IF IC: limiting amplifier and quadrature detector (SIL-4: in, gnd, vcc, out). Engine (bw-board fm_if): input 330 Ohm to an internal bias (the ceramic filter's termination); output behind 5 kOhm at half the supply plus Kd atan(2Q (f_i - f_q)/f_q) A^2/(A^2 + A_lim^2), f_i the IF's instantaneous frequency, Q 20, Kd 1 V/rad, limiting from 30 uV; the knob tunes the quadrature tank f_q +-150 kHz around quadHz (10.7 MHz). Reports detector, quadHz.
